current_date: 2014-07 (cover text reads 'Planning Application Validation Requirements July 2014'; the council publishes the file as 'validation document 2017' / 'June 2017')
current_evidence: Searches found no newer North Warwickshire list. The planning.data.gov.uk local-area-requirements record for the council (entry 2024-07-11, no end date) points to the 'Planning Application Validation Document - June 2017', which is this file (370).

issues.detail: The list date of 2007-12-01 ('adopted in December 2007') belongs to the earlier document this list replaced, not to this list. The cover is dated July 2014, and the council titles the file 'validation document 2017' (June 2017).
issues.evidence: 'It replaces the Council's previous "Planning Application Requirements" document adopted in December 2007.'; cover: 'Planning Application Validation Requirements July 2014'

issues.detail: The list is current but stale. It still cites saved policies of the 2006 Local Plan (e.g. ENV6, ECON9), BS 5837:2005 and the EIA Regulations 2011, and says 'It will next be reviewed in 2012'. The 'Planning page' column holds only the council homepage (https://www.northwarks.gov.uk), not a planning or validation page.
issues.evidence: 'to allow assessment under saved policy ENV6 of the North Warwickshire Local Plan 2006'; 'It will next be reviewed in 2012, or sooner if necessary.'

issues.detail: Householder shows '(none)', but the source sets local requirements for householder applications: a Conservation Area Statement if the site is within or adjoining a Conservation Area, and a Listed Building Consent application if the dwelling or site contains listed buildings.
issues.evidence: Householder 2.2b Local Requirements: 'If the application site is located within or adjoining a designated Conservation Area, then the Council will require a Conservation Area Statement.'

issues.detail: Several other application types show '(none)' despite local requirements in the source. Outline omits the Phase I Environmental Report (new dwellings or sensitive uses in areas of potential contamination or land gas), the Coal Mining Risk Assessment (Coal Mining Development Referral Area) and the FRA. Listed building consent omits the Detailed Schedule of Work and Structural Survey. Demolition in a conservation area omits the Demolition Statement. Works to trees omits the tree professional report (health/safety) and engineer plus arborist reports (subsidence). Variation of condition s73 omits the full justification. Change of use - prior approval omits the traffic/flood evidence and the Phase One report if requested. Lawful development cert omits the dated evidence of use and scaled plans.
issues.evidence: Coal Mining Risk Assessment in Full (3.2b) and Outline (4.3b) sections; Detailed Schedule of Work for 'Listed Building applications with structural or repair works'

issues.detail: Many Appendix B local requirements are not captured at all: Conservation Area Statement; Air Quality Assessment (in or next to an AQMA); Supporting Planning Statement (major, inappropriate development in the Green Belt, loss of tourist accommodation); Heritage Statement (next to a Scheduled Ancient Monument, Historic Park/Garden or battlefield); Local Services/Community Facilities Statement (loss of services or facilities); Agricultural/Rural Economy Statement (new dwellings outside development boundaries, agricultural buildings, farm diversification); Affordable Housing Statement; Open Space Statement; Landscape Appraisal (major applications at or beyond settlement edges); Landscaping Maintenance Statement; Site Waste Management Plan (all major); Draft S106/CIL heads of terms (major, departures, affordable housing); Green Travel Plan (major); Hedgerow historical report (hedgerow removal); and Demolition Statement.
issues.evidence: Appendix B, e.g. 'Site Waste Management Plan - All major applications'; 'Air Quality Assessment - development in or next to an Air Quality Management Area'

issues.detail: Several triggers quote the wrong text. 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' quotes the Phase I Environmental Report requirement, not a highways requirement. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' quotes the BS 5837 tree method statement text. Ecological Survey and Energy/Sustainability Statement share a generic time-extension paragraph ('17.3 There are certain eligibility criteria...'). The real Sustainability Statement trigger is departures from the Plan, EIA applications and ECON2 applications.
issues.evidence: Highways row excerpt: '...a Phase I Environmental Report MUST be submitted.'

issues.detail: Several triggers are cut off and lose their thresholds. Coal Mining reads only 'use application, a Coal Mining Risk Assessment MUST be submitted', dropping the Coal Mining Development Referral Area condition and the change-of-use exemption. FRA reads only 'may be necessary', dropping sites of 1ha+ in Flood Zone 1 and Zones 2/3. Roof plan is just 'and the roof plan.' Noise runs into a list of saved policies and omits the trigger (noise-sensitive development or proposals next to noise-sensitive sites).
issues.evidence: Coal Mining Risk Assessment: full and outline applications in a Coal Mining Development Referral Area, other than change of use

issues.detail: Every Full planning row is marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', although the source is organised by application type in sections 2-17. Requirements that apply to several types (e.g. Coal Mining, Phase I, FRA for full and outline) were not placed under those types. The Structural Survey, which applies to listed/conservation-area buildings and rural building conversions (ECON9), was placed only under Full planning.
The only tab item is process text about electronic submission (CD/USB), not a requirement. The 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' row is advice, not a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: 'Electronic submission of applications is strongly encouraged, either via the Planning Portal, or by CD or a USB storage device.'; 'of requesting a pre-application discussion with Planning Officers is crucial.'

summary: Grokbot links the only published North Warwickshire list, but dates it to 2007, the date of the document it replaced; the cover says July 2014 and the file is titled 2017. The extraction is very thin: most application types show '(none)' although the source sets type-specific local requirements, about 15 Appendix B requirements are missing, and several triggers belong to other items.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
